    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BlueCoin
    Reward coin that activates the Ghost effect when collected by a game session.
    Coin
    Places a reward on an unoccupied board cell and supplies its point value.
    CoinSpawnPolicy
    Selects the next reward or hazard type from a controller-supplied random roll.
    CoinSpawnPolicy.CoinType
    Pickup types that the controller can spawn after collecting a reward.
    DirectionInput
    Accepts at most one valid turn per tick and requires a new turn after a shield save.
    EffectManager
    Refreshes an effect of the same type while allowing different effect types to coexist.
    EffectType
    Kinds of move-limited effects supported by the game.
    Game
    Stores board dimensions, difficulty, target progress, and awarded points for one round.
    GameController
    Connects keyboard input and the animation timer to the round state and game view.
    GameSession
    Owns one round of snake, food, walls, and effects; reset recreates its mutable state.
    GameSession.MoveResult
    Outcome of a move before pickup processing.
    GameSession.Pickup
    Kind of item reached after a successful move.
    GameView
    Draws the board, pickups, snake, score, and timed-effect notices using JavaFX.
    GhostEffect
    Lets the snake cross board edges and preset walls while active.
    GoldCoin
    Reward coin with a higher point value than a regular coin.
    Level
    Immutable level configuration with defensive copies of its wall positions.
    LevelCatalog
    Loads the ordered level index and map resources from the classpath.
    LevelParser
    Validates a header and dot/hash grid and converts them into a level.
    Main
    Starts the JavaFX application and exposes the view manager used by the FXML menu controller.
    MainMenuController
    Reads the selected level and difficulty from the menu and starts a game round.
    Obstacle
    Stores fixed and generated wall cells for a round.
    PoisonCoin
    A purple hazard placed apart from the reward coin.
    PowerUpFactory
    Creates a fresh timed effect for a requested effect type.
    RainbowCoin
    Reward coin whose speed bonus applies until the next reward is collected.
    ShieldCoin
    Reward coin that activates a one-hit shield when collected.
    ShieldEffect
    Absorbs one lethal move before its duration expires.
    SilverCoin
    Reward coin that causes the controller to add obstacles when allowed.
    SlowCoin
    Reward coin that temporarily reduces the movement rate when collected.
    SlowEffect
    Reduces movement rate for a limited number of moves.
    Snake
    Tracks head and body positions and resolves wall, border, and self collisions.
    TimedEffect
    Base class for effects whose remaining duration is counted in moves.
    ViewManager
    Creates the menu and game windows and switches between them.
